notes: VD04 uses Tongsheng 0x59 UART. ParseDisplayUartFrame writes PAS 0–6 to 0x20002706 and max speed to 0x20002705 when the speed byte is greater than 10. Handlebar on-road/off-road hold-toggle stays on the display; the motor has one ceiling and applies whichever km/h the display sends.

CompareWheelSpeedCeiling (0x10008810) cuts assist when wheel speed at ride-state+0x38 is >= kmh<<5. Stock 25 km/h is why a display 50 does nothing. Unplugging the speed sensor leaves +0x38 low, so the cap never fires. Other movs #0x19 sites are an 800-tick timeout, a current-staging +800, and fade-hi*25/22 — not a second speed wall.

ApplyAssistLevelTargets maps PAS 1–5 to percent immediates (30/50/70/85/100) at g_bAssistPercent (0x200026F9). CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent multiplies filtered torque demand by that byte. A separate FOC cap at g_wScaledAssist uses soft-float 0.4/0.5/0.8/0.9/1.0; PAS1 and PAS3 share a mantissa word, so those doubles are not exposed.

PAS 0 is zero. PAS 6 is walk: RunRideControlLoop stores 450 into wCurrentTarget (ride-state+0x12). ApplyAssistLevelTargets then zeros the percent cell and writes 3/16 of full current into the other target words.
Startup 1000 and 728 values in InitializeRideDefaults are written once to 0x200025AC / 0x2000258A with no second code xref proving they clamp PWM or current. They are not in this map.
Rider settings change everyday speed/PAS/walk behavior. Advanced tunables are FOC, stall, hall, PAS pulse timing, and protection constants — wrong values can stall, cut assist, or rotate commutation.

The VD04 max speed byte is 60. Raising the motor ceiling to 60 still fades assist as wheel period drops below the 60 km/h fade table. Unlimit-when-display-60 skips the hard ceiling and remaps a stored 60 to 99 for fade math. Disable-fade stores full current on both fade paths. Unlimit-power skips battery OC flags, the current slew, and the two ride-loop target clamps.

parameters.label: Speed ceiling
parameters.summary: Hard motor speed wall. Assist is cut when the wheel sensor says you reached this km/h. Stock is 25, which is why a display set to 50 still dies at 25. Raise this so off-road display speeds can actually apply.
parameters.notes: CompareWheelSpeedCeiling: movs r3, #kmh then lsls #5. If ride-state+0x38 >= that value, bit 0x40000 (assist allow) is cleared. Raise this so a VD04-sent off-road speed can actually apply. Does not remove limiting.

parameters.label: Default max speed
parameters.summary: Boot-up max speed only. The display overwrites it as soon as it sends a speed greater than 10. Leave this unless the display is unplugged or not talking.
parameters.notes: InitializeRideDefaults writes this byte to 0x20002703 and 0x20002705. UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod uses those bytes for the +0x30/+0x32 fade table. A live 0x59 frame overwrites 0x20002705 when the display speed byte is > 10, so this only sticks with a silent display.

parameters.label: Default wheel-size code
parameters.summary: Boot-up wheel-size code (Tongsheng 6–34, stock 28). Not millimeters. The display usually overwrites this; it only matters if the display never sends a wheel byte.
parameters.notes: InitializeRideDefaults stores 0x1C (28) to 0x20002702 and 0x20002704. UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod treats 0x20002704 as the Tongsheng wheel-size byte (valid 6–34). The display usually overwrites it; this is the silent-display default, not circumference in mm.

parameters.label: Default PAS level
parameters.summary: PAS level used from power-on until the display sends the first valid frame. After that the handlebar buttons own it.
parameters.notes: InitializeRideDefaults writes 5 to 0x20002706 before the first 0x59 frame. ParseDisplayUartFrame then overwrites it from assist-flag bits (0–5, or 6 = walk). Used until the display talks.

parameters.label: PAS 1 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 1 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 30%). Raise for more help on level 1. This is not the FOC current cap.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets writes 30 to g_bAssistPercent. CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent multiplies filtered torque demand by this byte. The FOC current cap for PAS 1 is a separate soft-float 0.4 and is not this immediate.

parameters.label: PAS 2 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 2 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 50%). Raise for more help on level 2.
parameters.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 50%. FOC cap for PAS 2 is half of max current (ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo -1), not this byte.

parameters.label: PAS 3 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 3 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 70%). Raise for more help on level 3.
parameters.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 70%. FOC cap is soft-float 0.8 sharing a mantissa word with PAS 1, so that cap is not separately patchable.

parameters.label: PAS 4 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 4 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 85%). Raise for more help on level 4.
parameters.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 85%. FOC cap is a separate soft-float 0.9.

parameters.label: PAS 5 assist
parameters.summary: Strongest pedal-assist level, not walk. Stock is already 100% of the torque-sensor demand.
parameters.notes: Strongest pedal-assist percent (not walk). Torque-demand multiply is 100%. FOC cap copies the max-current setpoint unscaled.

parameters.label: Walk-assist target
parameters.summary: How hard walk-assist pushes (stock 450 firmware units). Does not change how you enter walk on the display, only the current while walk is on.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop when PAS==6: movs r0, #255; adds r0, #imm; strh to ride-state+0x12 (wCurrentTarget, same field as pedal assist). Stock imm 0xC3 gives 450. Only one such add exists in the image. Does not change the hold-button walk entry.

parameters.label: Unlimit speed when display sends 60 km/h
parameters.summary: When the display is on its 60 km/h max, ignore the motor speed wall and treat 60 as 99 for fade math so assist can continue above 60. A display 25 (on-road) is left alone.
parameters.notes: VD04 will not send more than 60. This turns CompareWheelSpeedCeiling into an always-allow (bcc→b) so the 25/60 km/h wall never clears assist, and remaps a live display 60 to 99 in UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod so the fade table is built for 99 km/h. On-road 25 from the display is unchanged. Use Disable speed fade if you want no taper at any display speed.

parameters.label: Disable speed fade (full power always)
parameters.summary: Stop tapering assist as you approach the display speed. The motor stays at full requested power instead of fading out near the cap.
parameters.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade: skip the too-fast cut and interpolate on both the normal and walk/else paths, and store the full current/limit. Wheel-period fade no longer tapers assist as you approach the display speed. The hard CompareWheelSpeedCeiling is separate — also tick Unlimit speed when display sends 60 if you want to ride past 60.

parameters.label: Unlimit power and battery current
parameters.summary: Turns off the firmware battery-current limiter and the ride-loop power clamps so the motor can use more current. Can overheat the controller. Does not change PAS 1–5 sliders.
parameters.notes: Skips UpdateBatteryCurrentLimit overcurrent flags (0x8000000 and 0x10000000) and always takes the raise-slew path so the battery limiter does not wind the setpoint down. Also skips both RunRideControlLoop clamps that store g_wMaxCurrentSetpoint / g_wFullCurrentLimit over wCurrentTarget. Does not change PAS percents or FOC soft-float scales. Can overheat the controller or trip hardware protection.

parameters.label: Speed-fade assist floor
parameters.summary: Minimum assist left when speed-fade starts cutting (stock 600). Raise to keep more power as you near the cap; unused if Disable speed fade is on.
parameters.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade: movs r6,#imm; lsls #3. Stock 75<<3 = 600 added as the low-speed assist-limit floor (and the +600 term in the fade interpolate). Skipped while PAS==6.

parameters.label: PAS stuck-high timeout
parameters.summary: How long a PAS sensor pin can stay high before the motor decides pedaling stopped (stock 2000 ticks).
parameters.notes: UpdatePasCadencePeriod: if P0.4 high-time > imm<<4, period saturates to the stopped value. Stock 0x7D<<4 = 2000.

parameters.label: PAS stopped period
parameters.summary: Cadence period written when the PAS sensor looks stopped (stock 4100). Larger means it waits longer before calling you stopped.
parameters.notes: Literal 0x00001004. Low-time counter saturates here and the same value is written as the stopped cadence period (also used after the stuck-high timeout).

parameters.label: PAS min high-time
parameters.summary: Ignore very short PAS pulses (noise). Stock needs more than 7 ticks of high time before a pedal pulse counts.
parameters.notes: UpdatePasCadencePeriod: falling-edge period is committed only if high-time > this cmp. Stock 7 means a committed pulse needs at least 8 ticks. Glitch filter, not a rider PAS level.

parameters.label: Shunt low-band
parameters.summary: Current-shunt threshold that clears a protect flag when the reading is this low (stock 75). Not a rider PAS level.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: if averaged shunt < this cmp, the protect fade cell is reloaded and bit 0x2000000 is cleared. Stock 75.

parameters.label: Torque slew current floor
parameters.summary: Minimum FOC current during the torque slew window (stock 300). Raise for a stronger floor while torque is ramping.
parameters.notes: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit: movs r0,#255; adds r0,#imm; if foc-state+0x10 < that, clamp to it. Stock 255+0x2D = 300. Assist floor during the slew window.

parameters.label: Torque slew timeout
parameters.summary: How many samples the torque slew may run before it aborts and restores the saved motor angle (stock 50).
parameters.notes: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit: abort after sample index > this cmp; clears flag bit 4 and restores the saved electrical angle. Stock 50.

parameters.label: PLL rate clamp high
parameters.summary: Upper limit on the motor’s electrical-speed tracker (stock 2400). Wrong values can make the FOC loop hunt or lose lock.
parameters.notes: ProcessParkCurrentPiLoop: movs r2,#imm; lsls #5. Upper clamp on the PLL/electrical-rate cell. Stock 75<<5 = 2400. Asymmetric vs the -1024 low clamp.

parameters.label: PLL rate clamp low
parameters.summary: Lower limit on the same electrical-speed tracker (stock −1024). Pair with the high clamp; do not set this to a large positive number.
parameters.notes: Literal int32 0xFFFFFC00. Lower clamp on the same PLL/electrical-rate cell as pll_rate_clamp_high.

parameters.label: Stall mag-squared
parameters.summary: If measured motor current looks weaker than this, the firmware treats it as a stall and equalizes PWM. Raise to stall less easily; lower to trip sooner.
parameters.notes: ProcessSvmPwmAndStallProtect: if Clarke mag^2 at sample-state+0x34 is below this literal, SVM equalizes PWM to mid-rail and may ResetFocStateVerifyChipId. Stock 20000. Raising makes stall harder to trip; lowering trips easier.

parameters.label: Stall phase-balance count
parameters.summary: Second stall trip: if two phase currents stay almost equal for this many counts, PWM is equalized (stock 32000).
parameters.notes: Same stall path if phase-balance counter (pll-state+2) >= imm<<8. Stock 0x7D<<8 = 32000. Counter increments while |Ib-Ic|<16, max 64000.

parameters.label: Hall angle offset
parameters.summary: Rotates the hall-sensor electrical angle by 60° stock. Not a speed or power knob. Wrong values make the motor noisy, weak, or jerk.
parameters.notes: HandleHallSixStepCommutation adds this literal to LookupHallCommutationAngle. Stock 0x1555 = 65536/6 = 60 electrical degrees. Not a speed or PAS knob; wrong values rotate commutation.

parameters.label: Clarke mag IIR (new)
parameters.summary: How much the latest current-magnitude sample affects the stall detector (stock 2768). The matching “previous” weight 30000 is locked so the pair still adds to 32768.
parameters.notes: ProcessClarkePhaseCurrents: movs r1,#imm; lsls #4. Q15 weight for new mag^2. Stock 0xAD<<4 = 2768. The previous-sample weight 30000 at 0x100094B4 is fingerprint-locked so 2768+30000 stays 32768 unless you also leave that pair consistent.

preserve.label: UART start-byte compare (0x59)
preserve.notes: ParseDisplayUartFrame cmp r1, #0x59. Breaks VD04 pairing if changed.

preserve.label: Speed compare left-shift
preserve.notes: CompareWheelSpeedCeiling lsls r3, r3, #5. Must stay so the ceiling stays in +0x38 units.

preserve.label: PAS destination pointer
preserve.notes: Literal for 0x20002706. 0x59 flag bits write PAS 0–6 here.

preserve.label: Walk PAS compare
preserve.notes: RunRideControlLoop cmp r6, #6 before storing the walk target. Do not change; PAS 6 is walk.

preserve.label: Init protocol byte 0x43
preserve.notes: InitializeRideDefaults stores 0x43 into the second-UART/header block. Framing, not a rider limit.

preserve.label: XMC1302 IDCHIP compare
preserve.notes: ResetFocStateVerifyChipId hangs if SCU IDCHIP[23:8] != 0xF1C0. Never patch.

preserve.label: Clarke mag IIR (previous)
preserve.notes: Literal 30000. Complementary Q15 weight with clarke_mag_iir_new (2768+30000=32768).

preserve.label: PAS stuck-high left-shift
preserve.notes: lsls r2, r2, #4 after the stuck-high movs.

preserve.label: PLL high-clamp left-shift
preserve.notes: lsls r2, r2, #5 after the PLL high movs.

preserve.label: Stall balance left-shift
preserve.notes: lsls r2, r2, #8 after the phase-balance movs.

preserve.label: Clarke IIR new left-shift
preserve.notes: lsls r1, r1, #4 after the IIR-new movs.

preserve.label: Speed-fade floor left-shift
preserve.notes: lsls r6, r6, #3 after the fade-floor movs (75<<3 = 600).
